(Currently Amended) Claim 7 (Previously Presented): A method for preventing or treating glaucoma wherein _the compound_ (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof _are administered in a manner shown to be effective for the prevention of glaucoma._

(Currently Amended) Claim 8 (Previously Presented): A method for preventing or treating ocular hypertension wherein _the compound_ (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof _are administered in a manner shown to be effective for the prevention of ocular hypertension._
